set: B: one sheet across each acting state

reads.read: calm, a bit wary; it drops onto a form and glides from the Email field up to First name, which then lights up. It is about to start filling in the form
shocked and in pain; a bullet comes across the keyboard, hits it with a flash and leaves a hole. It reels and spins, then flees toward F as more shots come in
panicked, dodging; it is still under fire, gets hit or scorched into a ragged crumpled shape, recovers, then darts across the keys to L near Enter
tired, grudging relief; the email is 'accepted. Reluctantly.' It pokes the field, flies off the keyboard to an empty page, finds a Resume and pulls it close, almost hugging it
desperate and protective; it grows arms and hands to hold its Resume as a shredder pulls the paper down. It strains and rocks in a tug-of-war
losing, then grief; the resume is eaten bit by bit, the arms go limp and vanish, and it sags, tilts and droops over the shreds, defeated
broken; it comes back as blurred strips, falls into the shred pile, half reforms, then ends as a crumpled limp blob under the empty shredder

issues.what: it grows two black rubber-hose arms that end in small black mitten hands, which grip the Resume. Gloved hands and limbs are forbidden
issues.fix: cut the arms and hands. Make the arrow itself hold on: pin the paper with its tip, or bend its body or tail over the page and pull back, stretching as the shredder tugs

issues.where: frames 1-5, the arms holding the paper
issues.what: the same black arms and mitten hands; in frame 5 they dangle alone under a flattened arrow, so they are clearly limbs
issues.fix: remove them, and play the losing grip and the let-go through the arrow's own bend, sag and tilt

issues.where: frames 2-11, the move from Email to First name
issues.what: it glides along like a pointer: the same rigid pose, no anticipation, no lean and no stretch over the move, and no squash when it arrives at First name
issues.fix: crouch it (squash) before it moves, lean and stretch it along the path, and overshoot and settle with a small squash on the field

issues.what: there is no wind-up and no squash on the hit. The flash hides the arrow, and the tumble frames after it are thin, rotated, broken-up shapes that do not read as a silhouette
issues.fix: show one clean frame of the arrow squashed or bent away from the bullet, then hold a clear shocked recoil pose for 2-3 frames before the spin

issues.what: the arrow turns into a torn, ragged sprite and doubled ghost images; it is unclear whether it is hurt, smeared or a different object
issues.fix: keep one clear damaged silhouette (arrow plus holes or a dent), use a smear only for 1 frame on fast moves, and hold the hurt pose before the dash

issues.what: it jumps from the keyboard to an empty page with no transition, and its 'reluctant' feeling is not acted; then it slides toward the Resume in one rigid pose and its grow in frame 12 is only a scale-up
issues.fix: add a slump or sigh beat after 'Reluctantly', an anticipation before it leaves, and lean or tilt it toward the Resume to show it wants it

issues.what: the streaked, blurred strips do not read as the arrow, and the last pose is a melted blob that has lost the arrow shape, so the character is unclear at the end
issues.fix: keep the strips arrow-coloured with one arrowhead visible, and end on a bent, crumpled but still clearly arrow-shaped silhouette, held for 4+ frames

issues.what: the droop and turn away is good, but its sag is only a rotation with no squash; grief reads a little weak
issues.fix: add a slight vertical squash and a lower position to the sad hold

issues.what: did not read: confident reads as calm and a bit wary.
issues.fix: The upright stand, the slight bounce and the strut of Confident, held.

issues.what: did not read: nervous reads as panicked and dodging.
issues.fix: The beads of sweat, the small tremble and the gulp of Nervous held on a still arrow before it moves.

issues.what: did not read: proud reads as tired, grudging relief.
issues.fix: The puff up and the dusting of Proud, held with the paper.

issues.what: did not read: angry reads as desperate and protective.
issues.fix: The red tip and the vented steam of Angry plain at the size of the sheet, with the pull acted as temper.

issues.what: did not read: scared reads as losing, then grief.
issues.fix: The pale, stony arrow leaning back of Scared held before the loss.

issues.what: did not read: exhausted reads as broken. The sag and the drag are not in the read, and the last pose reads as a blob that has lost the arrow.
issues.fix: The sag and the soft edges of Exhausted on a shape that stays an arrow, the drag and the slump against something held.
